verdict.rationale: SendGrid explicitly documents the Inbound Parse webhook, which parses incoming email (headers, body, attachments) delivered via MX records to a URL of the developer's choice, directly matching the story [sendgrid-docs-8][sendgrid-docs-25]. Community evidence corroborates real-world inbound usage, albeit with a noted SPF/DKIM hiccup [sendgrid-comm-1], but does not contradict the core capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of attachment/header parsing fidelity and more detailed MX/DNS setup walkthrough beyond the doc stub.
